profile.headline: SWE @ Google
profile.summary: As an iOS Engineer on the Google Photos team, I specialize in building high-performance, front-end features that reach millions of global users. I leverage a deep technical foundation in Swift and Objective-C to transform complex ideas into intuitive, fluid mobile experiences.

positions.title: L3 Software Engineer
positions.description:
iOS developer for Google Photos

I work on frontend features that impact the ways users interact with the Google Photos app. I’m involved in projects finding the most creative ways to have users free up their storage.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: I worked on the Street View team for Google Maps. My project was creating an immersive Street View randomizer that would take users to around the world. I primarily learned and used Objective-C for the front-end.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: In the Assembly Electric department, I was tasked with the programming and managing of the assembly line testing devices. My work ranged from creating scripts for assembly production to creating applications for data processing, and  logging error traces. I utilized programming languages like Powershell, Python, Javascript, and C#

positions.title: Applecare Advisor
positions.description: I was given the role of assisting customers with any issues they were having with their IOS or iPadOS devices. This meant setting up repairs, troubleshooting software, and scheduling replacements. The job taught me how to communicate steps efficiently and concisely, as well as, learning to be patient and understanding of clients.
